model_annotation: Figure 3(a) illustrates the coverage versus voting completion rate for the Llama-1B, Llama-4B, and Mamba-4B models. The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions (N)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 24 to 128, with tick intervals of 8 and units of “number of completions”. The y-axis, labeled “Majority voting accuracy”, is a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, with tick intervals of 0.1. The first line, representing Llama-1B, is a solid black line, starting at a value of 0.32 and decreasing to approximately 0.12 by N=128. The second line, representing Llama-4B, is a solid green line, beginning at a value of 0.48 and decreasing toward 0.26 by N=128. Lastly, the third line, representing Mamba-4B, is a solid blue line, initiating at a value of 0.64 and decreasing to approximately 0.36 by N=128.
